question_summary: Request approval to substitute ABS DWV piping in lieu of specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping in Spec Section 22 13 16 prior to fixture rough-in and material order.
proposed_solution: Approve ABS DWV piping as an alternate to no-hub cast-iron soil piping.
deadline_text: Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order.
routing_rationale: This is a plumbing material substitution request under the plumbing specifications and requires the plumbing engineer of record’s approval.
